Dear [Dr Neale](/person/1078),
I enclose postage stamps for the paper taken up by the Honolulu letters.[^2] Pray thank [Sister Anne](/person/1816) for her kind note to me acknowledging the pin cushions.
yours faithfully

C M Yonge


[^2]: Queen [Emma](/person/485) of Hawaii visited Hursley in August 1865, and the Honolulu letters may have been in connection with this.
